title: Electrochemically embedded heterostructured Ni/NiS anchored onto carbon paper as bifunctional electrocatalysts for urea oxidation and hydrogen evolution reaction
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,14-25
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07418A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Saba A. Aladeemy, Prabhakarn Arunachalam, Mabrook S. Amer, Abdullah M. Al-Mayouf
The present work describes a facile way to introduce controllable heterostructured Ni/NiS on carbon paper (Ni/NiS@CP) via one-step electrodeposition, which improves both urea electrooxidation and hydrogen evolution.
